nmeaair_ownMmsi_help: Hide the own AIS transponder from the radar (the boat is already shown at the centre). Leave empty to show all AIS targets.
nmeaap2_alarmRadius_help: Numeric state (m) — when armed, the boat leaving this circle triggers the anchor alarm in the backend.
nmeaap2_anchorLat_help: A state with the latitude of the anchor position in decimal degrees, used only together with the longitude. If one of the two is empty: anchorAlarm.anchorPosition of the instance
nmeaap2_anchorLon_help: A state with the longitude of the anchor position in decimal degrees, used only together with the latitude. If one of the two is empty: anchorAlarm.anchorPosition of the instance
nmeaap2_anchorPosition_help: A state with "latitude;longitude". Empty: the anchor position of the anchor alarm of the instance (anchorAlarm.anchorPosition), unless latitude and longitude are chosen below.
nmeaap2_chainLength_help: A state with the deployed length of chain or rode: the radius of the swing circle
nmeaap2_depthAtDrop_help: A state with the water depth where the anchor touched the ground
nmeaap2_isAlarm_help: Boolean state — true while the anchor alarm is armed. Toggle from the widget dialog.
nmeaap_enableCompanion: Allow split view with Wind compass
nmeaap_enableCompanion_help: Adds a toggle in the fullscreen dialog (top-right in landscape, bottom-right in portrait) to show the Wind compass next to the Autopilot.
nmeahc_autoScale_help: Treat yMin/yMax only as suggestions and let the axis expand to fit the data
nmeahc_historySeconds_help: How many seconds of samples to keep and display
nmeahc_stateId_help: Path under the instance, e.g. windData.windSpeedApparent
nmeahc_yMax_help: Upper bound (exact when autoScale is off, otherwise a suggestion)
nmeahc_yMin_help: Lower bound (exact when autoScale is off, otherwise a suggestion)
nmeawc_closeHauledAngle_help: Half-angle of the port/starboard color bands at the bow.
nmeawc_enableCompanion_help: Adds a toggle in the fullscreen dialog (top-right in landscape, bottom-right in portrait) to show the Autopilot next to the Wind compass.
nmeawc_historySeconds_help: Seconds of AWA/TWA history used for the min/max shift sectors. 0 disables.
nmeawc_showSail_help: Overlay the mainsail at its optimal angle for the current apparent wind. Boom is set at half the apparent wind angle; sail is flat on close-hauled courses and becomes full and baggy as the wind moves aft.
